title: E0065: NoSQL injection
plain_english: This rule reports NoSQL query calls where user-controlled input reaches the query argument. In NoSQL systems, attacker-controlled operators or structures can change query behavior.
why_matters: NoSQL injection can bypass authentication, expose unintended records, or modify or delete data depending on the query and database permissions.
what_it_checks: MongoDB/PHPLIB-style method calls such as `insertOne`, `insertMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `replaceOne`, `deleteOne`, `deleteMany`, `findOne`, `find`, `aggregate`, `countDocuments`, `distinct`, and `createClient`
Cases where user-controlled input reaches these calls, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
